dog.description_text: My Foster writes: Ash is the sweetest boy who ever lived! He loves to be pet, especially when he is being held like a baby. He is extremely playful and enjoys hanging out around company. He truly is just another roommate - getting up on the couch during movie night. He really enjoys attention, and will meow to let you know if he needs any. He's the longest cat we've ever met, especially because he is so small in size. He will quickly become a friend to guests, even if he doesn't come out to greet them immediately. Watch out, he might try to steal your socks.
dog.name: Ash
